name: ACCM
note: Official Partner of Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP under a multi-year deal announced in February 2026 (Finance Magnates, 6 February 2026). A CFD broker focused on emerging markets; Finance Magnates reports regulatory licences in Australia and South Africa and offshore licences in Seychelles and Vanuatu, and names Tien Ching as CEO. Ownership not identified; left unrated.
